This dataset contains the three (3) files (.prj, .wtif, .tif) that create the orthomosaic captured by the Capture2Preserv team with the Sensefly Ebee Geo Fixed Wing Drone. Two hundred and thirty-seven (237) images were collected om the 12th May 2023 and processed in Pix4D Mapper V.4.7.5.
